name: MIA-Bench
intro: MIA-Bench是一个新的基准，旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）严格遵循复杂指令的能力。该基准包含400个图像-提示对，每个都旨在挑战模型在生成满足特定请求模式的准确响应时对分层指令的遵循。评估结果显示了最先进的MLLM在性能上存在显著差异，突出了指令遵循方面的改进空间。
org: Apple, NVIDIA, Roblox, New York University, Nanjing University, The Hong Kong University of Science
intro_en: MIA-Bench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to strictly follow complex instructions. It contains 400 image-prompt pairs, each intended to challenge models in generating accurate responses that meet specific request patterns while adhering to hierarchical instructions. Evaluation results reveal significant performance gaps among state-of-the-art MLLMs, highlighting room for improvement in instruction following.

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect diverse images from COCO 2017 validation, SBU, TextVQA, and Flickr sources"] --> B["Manually write complex prompts containing multiple layered sub-instructions for each image"]
    B --> C["Enforce answerability, no answer leakage, and a requirement to inspect the image"]
    C --> D["Label image content and categorize sub-instructions into eight instruction types"]
    D --> E["Design complexity levels from basic to complex and creative prompt forms"]
    E --> F["Assign sub-instruction weights from 1 to 10 with each prompt totaling 10 points"]
    F --> G["Generate MLLM responses and grade each component with GPT-4o as judge"]
    G --> H["Aggregate weighted component scores into final instruction-adherence percentages"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01509. The paper builds 400 image-prompt pairs from COCO 2017 validation, SBU, TextVQA, and Flickr images; manually writes complex layered instructions; enforces correctness, no answer leakage, and image-dependence; categorizes sub-instructions into eight types such as description, length limit, mention, genre, grammar, math, perspective, and OCR; assigns sub-instruction weights summing to 10; and uses GPT-4o as judge to score response adherence and aggregate model scores.
